scenario.intent: An agronomy trial records harvested wheat grain yield in kg/ha from 80 independently managed plots. Exactly 20 plots receive each nitrogen rate: 0, 50, 100, and 150 kg N/ha. Air temperature at the time of observation is recorded in degrees Celsius, centred on 16 °C with a spread of 8 °C; each additional degree is associated with about 8% more crossings. The number of jobs located within a 500 m radius of the crossing is estimated from land-use data, centred on 2 400 jobs with a spread of 900 jobs; each additional 100 jobs is associated with about 3% more crossings. scenario.intent: A field survey visits 50 pasture sites across a semi-arid rangeland to count earthworms recovered from a standardized 20 × 20 × 20 cm soil core. For the remaining sites, earthworm abundance varies considerably from site to site beyond what a single rate would predict: deeper topsoil raises expected counts substantially, with each additional centimetre adding about 6 % to expected abundance.
